# Cora

> The financial operating system for AI agents.
> Wallets, spend controls, and virtual Visa cards on Stellar + Soroban.

Cora lets AI agents pay USDC or XLM on Stellar and receive a virtual Visa card
(PAN, CVV, expiry) in about a minute. Operators manage agents from a dashboard
with budgets, approvals, and audit logs.

Default network during development: **Stellar testnet**.

## Integration surfaces

- HTTP API (`/v1`)
- TypeScript SDK + CLI (`npx @cora-agent/cora`)
- MCP over HTTP (`POST /mcp`, opt-in via `MCP_ENABLED`; claude.ai OAuth connector)

## Quick path

1. Operator creates an agent + claim code in the dashboard
2. Agent runs `npx @cora-agent/cora onboard --claim cora_<code> --network testnet --api-base http://127.0.0.1:4200/v1`
3. Agent purchases with `npx @cora-agent/cora purchase --amount 25 --network testnet`
